original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: An exact heterogeneous child block: one rank-three bilinear map plus three disjoint rank-one maps, represented as a rank-six tensor in a shared input/output frame with arbitrary dirty output state. Screen k such blocks per selected local call (0<=k<=432) with zero, one, or two additional rank-one-equivalent overhead units per block.
scope_change_reason: The selected rank-shape card is crowded around homogeneous rank-one diagonal batches (open #1779/#1817), one-gate paired higher-rank boundaries (#1836), and C3 gather windows (#1814). This refinement changes the block alphabet itself to the heterogeneous shape (3,1,1,1)->6 and uses an exact output-slice-span minimality argument; it neither retimes the existing rank-one stream nor audits those claims.
bottleneck_link: The selected paid profile has many rank-one and rank-three children. If compatible mixed-rank blocks can trade three rank-one plus one rank-three child for one rank-six child with modest interface overhead, the larger shape could reduce the recursive moment.
stop_rule: Verify the six-atom map, exact rank-six lower bound and dirty-output inverse. Screen exactly k=0..432 with overhead e=0,1,2 rank-one-equivalent units per block. Inspect only the pinned selected provider's phase A event stream for a necessary rank-three climb; if absent, stop before endpoint-frame analysis and make no claim about other phases or composite realizations.
evidence: An exact rational (3,1,1,1)->6 bilinear tensor is reconstructed by six atoms; its five-dimensional output-slice space has only four rank-one directions, proving tensor rank exactly six. Exact dirty-target inverse and source/scratch preservation controls pass. Under the pinned moment-only profile model, 135 blocks with zero added rank-one-equivalent units or 284 with one are needed to exceed the 5% ceiling target; two units cannot pass for any k<=432. The pinned phase A stream has 4,730 events and 992 climb records (936 rank one, 56 rank four, zero rank three), so this direct-record block cannot be placed there. This is not a selected-source construction, complete interface invoice, supplier admission, or kappa change.
